From the guardrail audit (PQ-28, PR #49, docs/audit/2026-10-guardrail-audit.md), audit tree 0c7d60a.

**GAP-8** (G-3, Major, new): Two live rooms on one question: releasing one publishes the answer at /last while the other is pre-reveal
- Evidence: rooms.rs:846-886 (create_for checks used only), rooms.rs:925 (global take_home), routes.rs:639; probe test
- What would close it: Refuse create_for while another unreleased room holds the question, with a test

Held: an audit's findings are the client's to release. Read the gap's section in the audit report before planning; re-verify on the current main.
data.title: Two live rooms on one question: releasing one publishes the answer at /last while the other is pre-reveal

data.body: Client ruling 2026-10-05: no second room. Refuse creating a room on a question while another unreleased room holds it.

DISPATCH (orchestrator, 10-06 07:3x) on the client's word ('Dispatch PQ-54'). Mode inline-full. Worktree /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/one-room-per-question, branch ai-c11-cc/one-room-per-question off origin/main @ e239346. Rulings: (1) a room holds its question while not Released and not ended(now); (2) the check and the insert under one rooms lock; decide whether the used check moves under it; (3) Run it again reaches the same check; the released source room does not count; (4) schedule() unchanged; (5) one new refusal sentence per SPEC §11, carried to the client for approval, plus a RUNBOOK failure-table row; (6) out of scope: smoke/burst --question q3 default (GAP-21), the machine-wide take_home, deploy, contract files. The tag 'held' stays; the client released this ticket for this dispatch.
READY PQ-54 CWD /Users/michellerojas/rust-nyc-pop-quiz-worktrees/one-room-per-question HEAD e239346f938896c91f14bc6a299fd3fce8d0bb7f BASE e239346f938896c91f14bc6a299fd3fce8d0bb7f MODE active

BLOCKED PQ-54: third commit (latch an ended room's ending in create_for, from the automated security review) is staged but cannot be signed. git commit: '1Password: failed to fill whole buffer' twice; ssh-keygen fallback via the 1Password agent socket (key listed by ssh-add -l): 'communication with agent failed'. Two signed commits already on the branch (4dfcf0c, d4d7859). Waiting for the client to unlock/approve 1Password.

ORCHESTRATOR FIX-BACK (exact-head review of b93de4f: PASS-WITH-NITS, attached). Review cycle 1 of the cap. One docs-only signed commit after the push, then push it, then FIXED PQ-54 HEAD <sha>, stay at review: (1) docs/RUNBOOK.md:326, give the numbers: a room stops holding its question after 30 minutes with no host action while it waits to start, 20 minutes once started, 4 hours at most (lifecycle.rs IDLE_QUIET/LATER_QUIET, rooms.rs ROOM_LIFETIME); and say what to do if the saved host-screen address is lost: wait for the room to go quiet, or pick another question. (2) In DONE and the PR body, do not call the thread test a witness for the lock: the questions lock serializes creates, so only the structural test guards the critical section; say that. (3) NIT: wrap the long doc line near rooms.rs:988. Leave the latch as is. Do not merge.

FIXED PQ-54 HEAD e170a6953d0c0a031371561163103119c46f41e8 (docs and comments only, signed, pushed; PR #50 https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/50). (1) docs/RUNBOOK.md row: 30 min with no host action before start, 20 min once started, 4 h at most, only host actions reset the clock; if the saved host-screen address is lost, wait for the room to go quiet and create again, or pick another question. (2) The threaded create test is now documented as a smoke check, not a lock witness (questions serializes creates); README and PR body name the structural test as the guard. (3) run_again_checked doc line rewrapped. Latch untouched. Not merged.

DONE PQ-54 PR https://github.com/mrojas54/rust-nyc-pop-quiz/pull/50 HEAD e170a6953d0c0a031371561163103119c46f41e8 BASE e239346f938896c91f14bc6a299fd3fce8d0bb7f test-room 250 passed / 0 failed / 4 ignored (at b93de4f, last code change; e170a69 docs-only, one_room 14 + used 14 + canary 12 + runbook.test.js 7 re-run green) test-warm 18.1s canary 12 passed, --full 13 passed mutations: M1 hold check off -> 8 one_room tests; M2 counts Released -> gap8_after_release_the_used_rule_refuses_not_the_hold + canary run_it_again_makes_a_new_room_and_never_reruns_the_question; M3 ignores ended -> quiet-idle, quiet-after-start, expired tests; M4 hold check under its own rooms lock -> structural test; M4b M4 + questions not held -> structural test; M5 used check before locks -> structural test; M6 questions dropped before insert -> structural test; M7 latch removed -> gap8_an_ended_room_stays_ended_once_a_new_room_is_let_in. The threaded test is a smoke check, not a witness: the structural test guards the critical section. rulings: client - create_for and run_again refuse while another unreleased room holds the question; (1) Room::holds = same question, not Released, ended(now) None, plus ending latched once a new room is let in; (2) questions->rooms held from checks to insert, used check moved under rooms (closes release-during-create), questions held (closes schedule swap); (3) run_again_for ends in create_for, released source holds nothing, tested; (4) schedule unchanged, doc comment only; (5) new sentence + RUNBOOK row with timer numbers; (6) smoke/burst, /last take_home, deploy, contract files untouched. comments-acted-on: client ruling 10-05 16:07Z; DISPATCH 10-06 11:29Z; ORCHESTRATOR FIX-BACK 10-06 12:35Z (all three items). copy-for-the-client: That question is open in another room. Pick another. deviations: 1) added a latched ending to Room (from the automated security review): ended(now) was recomputed per caller, so an earlier-now host action could revive a room whose ending let a new room in; 2) end-to-end validation ran on the test-full Discord mock over real TCP, not a desk binary, because the binary hardcodes discord.com; 3) harness_full burst_on_loopback_at_200 fails here on loopback resets, identically on base e239346 (environmental). Follow-up: smoke/burst 409 hint says restart, wrong for this refusal (GAP-21).

Merged as PR #50 (merge commit 2877149679cb5ccfa56806b43401dae65cd33fc0, merge-commit strategy, client's word 2026-10-07). PR head e170a69 CI green (just test, just test-full); main CI at 2877149 green (gh-wait-runs 1/1 success, run 37577743165). Fix-back items (1)-(3) closed at e170a69: RUNBOOK timer numbers and lost-link guidance, threaded test documented as a smoke check not a lock witness, doc line rewrapped. Guard for the critical section is the structural lock-order test; behavioural witnesses are the mutation results in the DONE comment and the 409 end-to-end validation. Follow-up outside scope: smoke/burst 409 hint says restart (GAP-21).

COPY APPROVED by the client (2026-10-07, in the delegator tab): "That question is open in another room. Pick another." No code change needed; the sentence ships as written in rooms.rs, tests/one_room.rs and docs/RUNBOOK.md.
Follow-up minted at the client's request: PQ-65, smoke and burst give the wrong 409 advice (restart) for this ticket's new refusal. The q3 default stays with PQ-41 (B).
